hook: Every apprentice adds a line to your shared Recipe; pour it as Phials on any unit, even another tribe's star.
loop: Get Phials and cast them: pile on one lamp or spread wide
Apprentices add Recipe lines, so every later Phial does more
The Herald, Psyche and Shipton pour the Recipe out in fights

growth.line: Ramps from about turn 6: a lamp gains about 10% of itself per stat line each turn.

feel.early: Thin: small bodies and a lone +1/+1 Phial
feel.mid: Recipe fills; choose lamp or spread every turn
feel.late: Full Recipe, Herald and Pavonia: a lamp grows fast

stars.why: Each copy adds a line, so every later Phial grows
One Phial splashes three units; slot layout becomes the puzzle
Steals another tribe's keyword into the Recipe for every Phial

card_short.u02: Drawn: copies the stats of spells on its neighbours
card_short.u04: After you cast the shop's spell or use an item: get a Phial
card_short.u05: Holding 2+ Phials at Start of Turn: get 1 gold
card_short.u06: End of Turn: get a Phial
card_short.u07: When played: Add a line, Hunker or Bristle 2
card_short.u08: End of Turn: grows the most-Phialed unit per spell cast
card_short.u09: Drawn. When it dies: casts the Recipe on its neighbours
card_short.u10: Spells cast on this also hit the units beside it
card_short.u11: When played: Add a line, Drawn, Swoop or +2 Attack
card_short.u12: After a Phial, grows the units next to its target
card_short.u13: Shop's spell costs 1 less and restocks once a turn
card_short.u14: Drawn. +1/+1 for each spell cast while recruiting
card_short.u15: Start of Combat Nightshade; adds a Nightshade line to the Recipe
card_short.u16: Start of Combat: biggest enemy loses your Recipe's stats and a keyword
card_short.u17: Your Phials are cast twice on their target
card_short.u18: Each turn: copy a board unit's keyword into the Recipe
card_short.u19: Start of Combat: casts the Recipe on every other friendly unit
card_short.x01: Free spell in hand: cast your Recipe on a unit
card_short.x02: A splash is one cast; Drawn gains once per spell
card_short.x03: Herald in F1 makes Burnet lines fire; in B3, none
card_short.x04: A golden copy's lines stay, and golden adds a bigger one

builds.name: The Lamp
builds.line: Pour every Phial on one unit, with Drawn moths beside it

builds.name: The Dispensary
builds.line: Fill the Recipe with keywords and spread Phials over the board

builds.name: The Pharmacy
builds.line: A few Phial makers feed another tribe; the Alchymist steals its keywords

liked: Burnt Ring Warden turns slot placement into the tribe's multiplier
The Alchymist: steal another tribe's keyword into every Phial, different each game
worries: Dame Pavonia and Primrose stat lines can still snowball; golden Pavonia needs a sim
The Alchymist's stolen keywords lack rulings; Treacle Painter hangs on the shop spell's price
changed: A unit's Phials scale with its size once a turn, ending the runaway lamp
Psyche, the Nurse and the Grinder now aim at the lamp and its neighbours
Shipton also strips a keyword; The Uncertain needs two held Phials
verdict: Rated 7 fun, 7.3 distinct; ranked first of three Moth designs. For players who love planning slots and writing their own spell.
